_comment: THE CLAUDE CODE CAPTURE NERVE. UserPromptSubmit + Stop both fire hooks/afferent-post.mjs — a fail-silent (~250ms), stdout-free, secret-scrubbing bridge that POSTs to the thalamus (:4113) as a 'code' afferent. UserPromptSubmit captures HIS words (source 'claude-code'); Stop captures WHAT HE WAS TAUGHT (last_assistant_message, source 'claude-code-teaching') — so the WHOLE learning turn (question + answer) flows into the ONE working memory with zero capture tax. Relative command (CWD = project root); never blocks the session; thalamus down = silent no-op. THE FORGE PACER (30 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs contract`, whose stdout IS injected by design — THE METHOD's 12-step order + the two anti-quiz-dump laws, re-read EVERY turn instead of once at skill-load (prose read once drowns after 40 turns; that is exactly how 8 of 12 steps went missing on the first live session). Silent unless a fresh, unclosed forge session exists; silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1). THE BOOT LINE (31 Jul 2026): SessionStart ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs boot` — read-only, never writes, at most two lines, silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1) and silent when there is no session and no history. It deliberately speaks on a STALE session: staleness silences the PACER, never the MEMORY. Companion: learnstate.mjs brief now splices the hippocampus rehydrate cartridge, so a fresh session arrives holding his durable memory instead of making him re-explain himself. THE TEACHING CONTRACT (31 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `teaching_contract.mjs print`. The pacer re-injected the METHOD every turn but the HOW-TO-TEACH rules arrived only once, at SessionStart — and the measured result over a 5-hour session was zero method-drifts and four teaching-drifts (scope, role, language, terminology). This organ closes that asymmetry: <=5 lines, drift-RANKED (the rule he has been failed on most is injected first), rotating (every other rule still resurfaces), with the already-closed-concepts line DERIVED live from sprint.json so it needs no maintenance. It also carries the turn clock that raises his explicitly-requested CONTEXT WARNING before compaction, instead of relying on the model to remember to warn him.
